articles.title: Alphabet Just Raised $85 Billion by Selling Its Own Stock. If You Own GOOGL, Here Is What That Means.
articles.excerpt: Google's parent company upsized its equity offering to $84.75 billion — the largest stock sale in corporate history — to fund AI data centres. The move cancels buybacks, dilutes shareholders, and signals that the AI spending race has outgrown even Big Tech's enormous cash flows.
articles.image_caption: Sundar Pichai, CEO of Alphabet, has called demand for AI computing power 'unprecedented'
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India and the US Are '99 Per Cent' Done on a Trade Deal. Here Is What It Means for Every NRI.
articles.excerpt: US Ambassador Sergio Gor says the bilateral trade agreement is imminent. Tariffs on Indian goods could drop from 50 to 18 per cent. For NRIs sending money, investing, or running businesses across both countries, the stakes are enormous.
articles.image_caption: India-US bilateral trade negotiations approach their final stages
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Broadcom Just Beat Every Estimate. Its Stock Fell 15 Per Cent Anyway. Here Is What NRI Investors Need to Understand.
articles.excerpt: Record revenue, record margins, record AI bookings — and the worst single-day drop in months. The AI trade is entering a new phase where perfection is not enough.
articles.image_caption: A semiconductor chip — the building block of the AI infrastructure boom
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The RBI Decides on Rates Tomorrow. The Rupee Is at 95.75, Oil Is Near $97, and NRI Money Is Caught in the Middle.
articles.excerpt: Most economists expect a hold at 5.25 per cent, but traders are split on whether a surprise hike could come. What the decision means for remittances, property investments, and equity markets.
articles.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India headquarters in Mumbai ahead of the June 2026 monetary policy decision
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Just Scrapped Capital Gains Tax on Foreign Bond Investments. Here Is Why NRIs Should Care.
articles.excerpt: The cabinet approved eliminating the 12.5 per cent tax on government securities as the rupee slides and oil threatens inflation. The RBI decides on rates tomorrow.
articles.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India headquarters in Mumbai
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SpaceX Just Set the Price for the Largest IPO in History. Here Is What NRI Investors Need to Know.
articles.excerpt: At $135 a share and a $1.75 trillion valuation, SpaceX's June 12 Nasdaq debut will dwarf every public offering before it. The numbers are extraordinary — and so are the risks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Oil Is Near $100. The US Just Proposed a 12.5 Per Cent Tariff on India. NRI Investors Face a Dual Shock.
articles.excerpt: Iran hostilities pushed Brent crude to $97.81 on Wednesday while Trump's trade office proposed new forced-labour tariffs on 60 economies — including India at the higher 12.5 per cent rate. Here is what it means for Indian markets and your portfolio.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Microsoft Just Lost Over $200 Billion in Market Value During Its Biggest AI Week of the Year. If You Hold MSFT, Here Is What Is Happening.
articles.excerpt: The stock fell more than 7 per cent across two sessions despite an Nvidia partnership, seven new AI models, an autonomous agent launch, and a quantum computing breakthrough. Wall Street is sending a clear message about the gap between AI announcements and AI earnings.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The OECD Just Warned of the Weakest Growth Since 2008. Oil Is Near $100. A Private Equity Giant Froze Withdrawals. Here Is What It Means for NRI Investors.
articles.excerpt: Three simultaneous shocks — a growth downgrade, a private credit rout, and escalating Gulf hostilities — converged on markets Wednesday. The diaspora's exposure is real.
articles.nri_angle: India imports 85%+ of crude oil — $98 Brent directly hits India's current account deficit and rupee. NRI alternative fund allocations face liquidity risk. US index fund concentration masks weakness.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Broadcom Reports Earnings Today. At $2.25 Trillion, It Is the Biggest AI Chip Test of the Quarter.
articles.excerpt: Wall Street expects $22.1 billion in revenue and $2.40 in adjusted EPS — both records — as the chipmaker's AI business doubles and oil prices push past $97 in the background.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The S&P 500 Just Hit 7,600. Only Two of Its Eleven Sectors Were Positive. If You Own a US Index Fund, Read This.
articles.excerpt: Information technology now makes up nearly 40 per cent of the S&P 500. Over the past five trading sessions, only tech and energy were in the green. For NRI investors, the diversified index fund is no longer as diversified as it looks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: A Fed Official Just Said a Rate Hike May Be Coming. If You Have a Mortgage, a Loan, or an H-1B, Read This.
articles.excerpt: Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack, a voting FOMC member, warned that monetary policy may not be restrictive enough to bring inflation to 2 per cent. The central bank meets on June 16. Markets are already pricing in a hike.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bitcoin Just Crashed Below $70,000 for the First Time Since April. The Sell-Off Has Multiple Triggers.
articles.excerpt: Eleven straight days of ETF outflows, Strategy's first Bitcoin sale in four years, AI stocks vacuuming up liquidity, and Iran tensions have combined to push BTC to its lowest level in two months.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors hold Bitcoin through US exchanges, ETFs, and Indian platforms. India's 30% flat crypto tax and 1% TDS make active trading especially costly in a falling market. Understanding the ETF outflow dynamics and derivatives positioning matters for timing decisions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Job Openings Just Hit a Two-Year High. If You Are on an H-1B or Looking for Work in America, Here Is What It Means.
articles.excerpt: Employers posted 7.6 million openings in April, the most since March 2024. For the first time since June, there is more than one job available for every unemployed American.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Alphabet Just Announced an $80 Billion Equity Raise. Berkshire Hathaway Is Investing $10 Billion. Here Is What It Means.
articles.excerpt: Google's parent company is pivoting from buybacks to massive share issuance to fund AI infrastructure. The move signals that the AI spending race has entered a new, more capital-hungry phase — and shareholders will feel the dilution.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: HPE Surges 29 Per Cent. Marvell Is Called the Next Trillion-Dollar Company. Micron Crosses $1,000. The AI Spending Boom Just Entered a New Phase.
articles.excerpt: In 24 hours, four companies made the same point: AI infrastructure spending is accelerating faster than anyone predicted. Here is what NRI investors need to know about the week ahead.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: SpaceX Will Go Public on June 12. At Up to $2 Trillion, It Will Be the Largest IPO in History. Here Is What NRI Investors Need to Know.
articles.excerpt: Elon Musk's rocket and satellite company plans to raise up to $86.5 billion in a single offering. Morningstar says it is overvalued by nearly half. The listing will test whether the current rally can absorb the largest capital extraction U.S. equity markets have ever seen.
articles.nri_angle: NRI tech professionals hold significant Nasdaq-100 exposure through 401(k)s and index funds. SpaceX's potential fast-track entry into the Nasdaq-100 means passive NRI investors will automatically become SpaceX shareholders. The Morningstar overvaluation warning is directly relevant to portfolio risk management.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The Global Smartphone Market Is Heading for Its Steepest Annual Contraction on Record. Budget Phones Under $150 May Disappear Entirely.
articles.excerpt: Counterpoint Research now projects a 13.9 per cent decline in 2026 shipments to 1.08 billion units. The memory chip shortage, worsened by the Iran war, is killing the low end of the market while Apple and Samsung pull further ahead.
